title: TheCivShow Podcast
author: TheCivShow
description: 2 History Buffs and 1 tech guy, all with a singular purpose to entertain you. MoySauce, Nystagmus, and Razing Zozo are filled with information and entertainment as the 3 hosts talk about which Civilziation Leader they would bring to Prom, why is Gilgamesh so darn handsome, and who put that Spy in my land? As the three talk about strategies used within civilization, they are open to light hearted conversations and deep dive into some history facts. Tune into TheCivShow every Sunday at 7PM ET over at https://twitch.tv/TheCivShow
